name: Kidnapped Elder Torntusk!
summary: Primal Torntusk of Revantusk Village says Vilebranch savages carried off her mate, Elder Torntusk, in a bold midnight raid. Spies say he is alive and held prisoner atop Jintha'alor, and she asks you to save him.

sections.title: A Midnight Raid
sections.body: Vilebranch savages struck Revantusk Village at midnight and took Elder Torntusk, mate of Primal Torntusk. Her spies say he is still alive, a prisoner atop Jintha'alor, capital of the Vilebranch in the southern Hinterlands. Primal Torntusk fears the village could not bear losing him.

sections.title: The Faceless Blood God
sections.body: Word is that Vile Priestess Hexx readies the captive for sacrifice to Hakkar, the faceless blood God.

sections.title: Once You Reach Him
sections.body: Reaching the Elder, you are told to move quickly, for the guards surely know of your arrival by now.

faq.answer: Vilebranch savages took him in a bold midnight raid on Revantusk Village.

faq.q: Where is Elder Torntusk being held?
faq.answer: Her spies say he is a prisoner atop Jintha'alor, capital of the Vilebranch in the southern Hinterlands.

faq.q: What fate awaits Elder Torntusk atop Jintha'alor?
aliases: what do vilebranch want with torntusk
faq.answer: Word is that Vile Priestess Hexx readies him for sacrifice to Hakkar, the faceless blood God.
Primal Torntusk is the mate of Elder Torntusk, and she asks you to save him.
